topic.label: Italian
topic.desc: Italian: the Italian language, its dialects and history, and the literature, cinema and culture of Italy from Dante to the present.

concepts.label: Italian Culture, Cinema and Society
concepts.desc: Italian cinema, art, music, regional culture and contemporary society and politics.

concepts.label: History of the Language and Dialects
concepts.desc: From Latin to the questione della lingua and Tuscan standard, and the regional dialects and languages of Italy.

concepts.label: Italian Grammar and Syntax
concepts.desc: Morphology and syntax of standard Italian: articles, agreement, verb conjugation, moods, tenses, clitic pronouns and word order.

concepts.label: Italian Literature
concepts.desc: Italian literature from Dante, Petrarch and Boccaccio through the Renaissance, Romanticism and modern writers.

concepts.label: Italian Phonetics and Pronunciation
concepts.desc: Sounds of Italian: vowels, double consonants, stress, intonation and regional pronunciation.

concepts.label: Translation and Usage
concepts.desc: Translation between Italian and other languages, register, idiom and specialised vocabulary.

skills.label: Culture Briefing
skills.desc: Explains a cultural practice, region or tradition, checked by sourcing each claim.

skills.label: Italian Film Analysis
skills.desc: Analyses films such as neorealist works for style and context, checked by timestamping each cited scene.

skills.label: Italian Lesson Planner
skills.desc: Plans a language lesson combining grammar and culture for a proficiency level, checked against CEFR descriptors.

skills.label: Dialect Identifier
skills.desc: Identifies which regional dialect a passage comes from by its features, checked by listing the diagnostic features.

skills.label: Etymology Tracer
skills.desc: Traces an Italian word from Latin or other sources, checked against etymological dictionaries.

skills.label: Questione della Lingua Explainer
skills.desc: Explains the debate over a national standard from Bembo to Manzoni, checked by citing primary texts.

skills.label: Verb Conjugator
skills.desc: Conjugates Italian verbs in every mood and tense including irregular forms, checked against standard conjugation tables.

skills.label: Grammar Correction
skills.desc: Corrects errors in Italian text and explains each rule, checked by citing the rule for every change.

skills.label: Subjunctive Trainer
skills.desc: Generates exercises on when the congiuntivo is required, checked by an answer key with the trigger for each item.

skills.label: Author and Period Context
skills.desc: Places an author in a literary movement and historical setting, checked against dated literary histories.

skills.label: Close Reading
skills.desc: Analyses a passage of Italian literature for form, imagery and theme, checked by quoting the supporting lines.

skills.label: Italian Metrics
skills.desc: Scans hendecasyllables and identifies rhyme schemes such as terza rima and the sonnet, checked by recounting syllables with elision rules.

skills.label: Pronunciation Coach
skills.desc: Diagnoses common learner pronunciation errors such as missing geminate consonants, checked by contrasting minimal pairs.

skills.label: IPA Transcriber
skills.desc: Transcribes Italian words into IPA with stress and gemination, checked against dictionary transcriptions.

skills.label: Stress Placement Guide
skills.desc: Identifies the stressed syllable of Italian words, checked against dictionary stress marks.

skills.label: False Friend Detector
skills.desc: Flags false friends and calques in a translation, checked by giving the correct equivalent with dictionary support.

skills.label: Glossary Builder
skills.desc: Builds a bilingual glossary for a domain, checked for consistency across the source text.

skills.label: Italian Translation
skills.desc: Translates text to or from Italian in a chosen register, checked by back-translation of key sentences.

mcp.name: DeepL
mcp.desc: Translate text and documents across 100+ languages, with your preferred styles applied
